title: Radius at Geocentric Latitude
text: Estimate radius of ellipsoid planet at geocentric latitude, 1 input, 1 output; {Units} sets the output units Metric, {Planet model}, {Flattening} and {Equatorial radius of planet} sets the radius of planet at equator. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Equatorial radius of planet
params.values: Radius of planet at equator 6378137 (default) | scalar
